steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Trophy my ass! You got a death wish or something?!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Both of you... that's enough. We'll be arriving shortly, and a bit of quiet would do us all good.
Horo drags Hella to the cabin where the Furorians are lodged, while Hypatia forces Synex into confinement within her quarters.
At last, peace settles over the ship. Through the chaos, the ill-fated sand vessel barely trembles, never straying from its path.
It continues to dutifully carry its passengers—a noble researcher, DisCity Sinners, refugees, an Apostle of Ashes, and an Aurum Secretum envoy—straight toward their destined arrival.
